Costco Chicken-Skewer Family Wraps

My Costco shortcut for family wrap night: same chicken, different finishes.

YIELD1 serving
TOTAL TIME15 min
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~500 cal | ~62g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: Heat the ready-cooked WestEnd chicken skewers following package instructions (air fryer used here).

Ingredients

Shared

  • 16 WestEnd Mediterranean-style grilled chicken skewers from Costco

Kid Skewer, Tortilla & Toum Plate

  • 2 Mission Street Tacos Flour tortillas (served alongside)
  • 1 tbsp Mezete TOUM garlic sauce
  • Cut baby cucumber sticks

Adult Cucumber-Ranch & Harissa Wraps (2 Wraps)

  • 2 Mission Carb Balance Soft Taco Flour tortillas
  • 1/3 of the iceberg, cherry tomato & pickled red onion salad
  • 1 tbsp Bolthouse Farms Cucumber Ranch (across both wraps)
  • 2 tsp SHUUG Original Harissa (1 tsp per wrap)

You want a high-protein family wrap night using ready-cooked Costco grilled chicken skewers with zero raw-meat prep and two distinct table finishes.

Method

Shared base

  1. 1.Heat all 16 ready-cooked chicken skewers in the air fryer according to package directions.

Adult Cucumber-Ranch & Harissa Wraps (2 Wraps)

  1. 2.Slide the warm chicken off 4 skewers and divide between 2 Carb Balance tortillas.
  2. 3.Pile on 1/3 of the crisp lettuce, tomato, and pickled onion salad.
  3. 4.Drizzle 1 tbsp cucumber ranch across the pair and 1 tsp harissa per wrap, then fold and serve.

Kid Skewer, Tortilla & Toum Plate · Kid Skewer, Tortilla & Toum Plate

  1. 2.Plate 2 warm chicken skewers (remove sticks and cut as appropriate for your child) with fresh baby cucumber.
  2. 3.Add 1 tbsp Mezete toum garlic dip in the side cup and serve with 2 Street Tacos flour tortillas.

SPLIT PLATE SERVING

Adult Cucumber-Ranch & Harissa Wraps (2 Wraps): Serve the adult portion as described above.

Kid Skewer, Tortilla & Toum Plate: Serve the kid portion as described above.

Keys to success

  • Combine shredded iceberg lettuce, halved cherry tomatoes, and drained pickled red onion; divide equally across the 3 adult servings.
  • Adult build (per adult): remove sticks from 4 skewers and divide chicken across 2 Mission Carb Balance tortillas. Top with 1/3 of the salad, 1 tbsp cucumber ranch across the pair, and 1 tsp harissa per wrap (2 tsp total).

If something fails

Chicken skewers dry out during reheating: Since the WestEnd skewers are already fully cooked, heat them just until warmed through in the air fryer rather than over-roasting.

Wraps get soggy from pickled onions and dressing: Drain the pickled red onions thoroughly before tossing the salad, and layer the chicken first on the warm tortilla before adding salad and ranch.

Storage and reheating

Store: Store leftover heated skewers and dressed salad in separate airtight containers in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

Reheat: Reheat chicken skewers in the air fryer for 2–3 minutes until warm, then assemble wraps fresh.

Lasts: 3 days refrigerated when components are stored separately.

Estimated nutrition

~500 cal | ~62g protein.

Yield: 3 adult servings + 2 kid servings. Adult 2-wrap serving is ~500 kcal / 61.6g protein (displayed as ~500 cal / 62g protein): 4 WestEnd skewers (300 kcal / 48g protein on Costco's 150 kcal / 24g per 2-skewer basis) + 2 Mission Carb Balance Soft Taco Flour tortillas (140 kcal / 12g protein) + 1 tbsp Bolthouse Cucumber Ranch (17.5 kcal / 0.5g protein) + 2 tsp SHUUG Original Harissa (20 kcal / 0g protein) + 1/3 produce salad (~23 kcal / ~1.1g protein). Kid serving is ~343 kcal / 28.3g protein (displayed as ~340 cal / 28g protein): 2 skewers (150 kcal / 24g protein) + 2 Mission Street Tacos Flour tortillas (150 kcal / 4g protein) + 1 tbsp Mezete TOUM garlic sauce (35 kcal / 0g protein) + ~50g assumed cucumber (~7.5 kcal / 0.3g protein). Pickling-brine sugar is uncounted.
